public.statistic: paired binary win rate among non-tied cases
public.subject_interface: One Boolean success result per independent case.

trial.dependence: cases are independent; outcomes are paired within case
trial.seed_to_case: the controller seed initializes the case generator

statistics.score: two times candidate win proportion among discordant pairs minus one
statistics.uncertainty: exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson bound transformed to [-1, 1]
statistics.positive_effect: the candidate wins more discordant pairs than the champion

variation.known: ties reduce the effective discordant-pair sample
